title: Fake Conad Plus app promises 10x loyalty points and hides Android malware
content_md:
A fake Conad Plus app offers ten times the usual loyalty points and conceals Android malware, according to D3Lab.

Original article: https://www.d3lab.net/fake-conad-plus-app-a-promise-of-10x-loyalty-points-conceals-android-malware/
